name: PastaPenguin
description: Join the flightless feast! PastaPenguin brings together penguins and pasta lovers for a deliciously fun crypto experience.
imagePrompt: A cheerful penguin wearing a chef's hat, juggling colorful pasta shapes like rotini and farfalle, with an arctic background filled with spaghetti icebergs.

name: LabZilla
description: Unleash the beast in the crypto lab! LabZilla is the ultimate fusion of science and fun, roaring its way through the Solana blockchain.
imagePrompt: A cartoonish Godzilla-like creature with lab goggles and a lab coat, standing amidst chemical flasks and colorful test tubes, with a vibrant city skyline in the background.

name: Suitopia
description: Dive into the world of wet wonders! Suitopia celebrates the wonders of oceanic adventures and the thrill of treasure hunting in the crypto sea.
imagePrompt: A playful deep-sea diver in a vintage diving suit, surrounded by playful sea creatures like dolphins and colorful fish, with sunken treasure chests in a coral reef setting.
